description: NTNU provides 2.5-dimensional CFD simulation and mesh files for ALPHEUS reversible lobe pump-turbine design. The source studies rotor-rotor gap and channel-width to rotor-diameter ratio as design variables. ANSYS CFX and TwinMesh are named dependencies, with spreadsheet CFD results described. The study examines efficiency and feasibility for low-head pumped-hydro energy storage. Coverage: No complete measurement interval or evaluation extent is stated in the reviewed source. Access: public native metadata describes the release and its formats. Licence: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Cost and current distribution access remain unknown. Caveats: Geometry optimisation does not establish commercial feasibility or operational efficiency. The configured cases are distinct from mechanical-load and validation releases. Meshes, software licensing, numerical convergence and results were not tested. Related pump studies cover validation and mechanical loads.
inputs: Rotor-rotor gap and channel-width to rotor-diameter design parameters.
name: Data underlying the research of Positive Displacement Reversible Pump-Turbine - Rotor-rotor gap and W/D ratio optimization
